name: tinta-dev-tooling
description: Dev-only tooling for Tinta. The app itself ships with zero dependencies and no build step (see docs/ROADMAP.md) — this package.json exists solely so `npx playwright test` has something to install against for the browser-level smoke specs in tests/. Nothing here is loaded by index.html. "type": "module" is needed for playwright.config.js's ESM import syntax and also quiets Node's reparse warning on the js/*.smoketest.mjs files.

scripts.smoketest: for f in js/*.smoketest.mjs; do node "$f" || exit 1; done
